2014_spells.greater-transport-via-plants: This spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant before.
Create a magical effect at a point you choose

Using 1 action, this spell creates a magical link between a Large or larger inanimate plant within range and another plant, at any distance, on the same plane of existence. You must have seen or touched the destination plant before. The effect lasts for 1 round.
